employees.label: Employees (headcount)
employees.definition: Number of SAP employees by headcount in countries where SAP has 50 or more employees representing at least 10% of its total (ESRS S1 disclosure in the Integrated Report's sustainability statement). Group total headcount was 109,973.

fte.label: Employees (full-time equivalents)
fte.definition: Full-time equivalents by region: EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), Americas (North America and Latin America) and APJ (Asia Pacific Japan); people on permanent contracts weighted by staffing percentage.

currentTax.label: Current income tax expense
currentTax.definition: Current tax expense by geographic location, Germany vs foreign (an expense under IFRS, not cash taxes paid; deferred tax shown separately in the note).

notes: SAP publishes no U.S. state data. Country headcount is disclosed only for countries with 50+ employees and at least 10% of the total (Germany, United States, India) in the ESRS S1 section of the Integrated Report 2024; regions are FTEs from the 20-F (EMEA/Americas/APJ, which the filing defines by continent, not by country list). Tax: SAP publishes no country-by-country tax report; the 20-F splits current income tax expense into Germany (€418m) and foreign (€1,516m) for 2024. Cash income taxes paid (€2,277m net) are reported only for the group. Germany appears twice in countries because headcount and tax come from different documents. The 20-F also lists owned real estate in Newtown Square, Palo Alto and Colorado Springs (U.S.), Bangalore, Sao Leopoldo, London, Ra'anana and Sofia, and non-current assets by region (Germany €7,351m, U.S. €26,840m, India €405m), which were not recorded because they are dominated by goodwill.
